text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval for compensation changes for 2022.

The TO Live - Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the 2022 compensation changes, as noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 3, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Direct that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 3, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live be made public, once approved by the Board, and after the affected employees have been advised.
